class.name: NetwPredictCarryAttempt
class.brief_description: What one run of a carry rule produced, and every probe it earned.
class.description: The evidence [method NetwPredictionEngine.attempt_carry] gathers, which [method NetwPredictionEngine.judge_carry] turns into a verdict. The two are separate because a rule is never trusted, only checked: gathering says what happened and judging says what the pool does about it, and a caller that wants to report the difference needs both. [method evidence] false is the case with nothing to judge, either no transition the rule could be replayed against or a recorded state the book no longer holds. Charge that as a refusal through [method NetwPredictionEngine.decline_carry] rather than handing the probes to a verdict that would convict the rule of the absence.

method.name: evidence
method.description: Whether there was anything to judge at all.

method.name: faithful
method.description: Whether the rule reproduced a transition the owner already recorded, within that field's own tolerance. This is the only probe that can see a rule reading the live world or one whose arithmetic is simply wrong, because both reproduce the recorded past incorrectly while looking entirely reasonable at the moment of the write.

method.name: finite
method.description: Whether every step returned a finite value.

method.name: pure
method.description: Whether the fold left the compared scope of the bound owner exactly as it found it. A rule that writes the body it describes is retired, because it disagrees with the history it is replayed against from then on.

method.name: residual
method.description: How far the replay landed from the transition it was judged against, and [code]-1.0[/code] where no replay measured one, which is every path but an unfaithful one.

method.name: same_type
method.description: Whether every step returned the type it was handed.

method.name: tolerance
method.description: The tolerance [method residual] was judged at, and [code]-1.0[/code] alongside an unmeasured residual.

method.name: value
method.description: What the fold reached, and [code]null[/code] wherever a probe refused it.

method.name: within_envelope
method.description: Whether the fold landed nearer the acknowledged value than a teleport would move the body. The envelope is the field's own declared distance, because the rule advances one field in one unit and the entity default is only the right number for it by coincidence.
